title: Extraxt From The Intelligence Report On September 7, 1932 - Zee Zoong Tao Medicine Shop - Strike Ended

Extract from the Intelligence Report on September 7, 1932

-------------

Zee Zoong Tao Medicine Shop - Strike ended

The greater part of the 200 shop assistants of the Zee
Zoong Tao Medicine Shop, 101 Avenue Road and its nine branches
in the Settlement and French Concession who declared a strike
on August 30 as a protest against the dismissal of an employee
in its 7th branch, 1204 Yates Road, resumed work this morning,
September 8 pending a settlement of the dispute.

Two representatives of the strikers called at the Social
Bureau at 3 p.m. September 7 and stated that they would resume
work on September 8 pending a settlement and requested the
organ in question to order the shop proprietor to issue full
pay to them for the period of strike. They were received
by Wong Kong, a staff member who promised to refer their request
to the Chief of the Bureau..

摘自1932年9月7日的情报报告

---

徐重道药房——罢工结束

位于爱文义路101号及其在公共租界和法租界的九家分店的徐重道药房（Zee Zoong Tao Medicine Shop）的200名店员中的大部分人员，曾于8月30日为抗议其位于亚达路1204号的第七分店解雇一名员工而宣布罢工，现已于今晨（9月8日）复工，以待争议解决。

两名罢工代表于9月7日下午3时前往社会局，表示他们将于9月8日复工以待争议解决，并请求该机构命令店主向他们支付罢工期间的全额工资。他们由该局职员黄公（Wong Kong，音译）接待，黄公承诺将他们的请求转呈局长。

Extract from the Intelligence Report of August 31, 1932.

----------

Zee Zoong Tao Medicine Shop - Strike

About 200 shop assistants of the Zee Zoong Tao
Medicine Shop, 101 Avenue Road and its nine branches
in the Settlement and French Concession declared a
strike at 7 a.m. August 30 as a protest against the
dismissal of an employee in its 7th Branch, 1204
Yates Road, on suspicion of having committed theft.
They are still out this morning, August 31. The
strikers are now demanding:-

1. That the dismissed person be reinstated.
2. That an apology be tendered by the employer to
the employees.

摘自1932年8月31日的情报报告。

---

徐重道药房——罢工

位于爱文义路101号及其在公共租界和法租界的九家分店的徐重道药房（Zee Zoong Tao Medicine Shop）约200名店员，为抗议其位于亚达路1204号的第七分店因涉嫌盗窃而解雇一名员工，于8月30日上午7时宣布罢工。截至8月31日今晨，他们仍在罢工中。罢工者目前要求：

1. 复职被解雇人员。
2. 雇主向员工道歉。

Sir,

Police on beat duty have been warned to keep a special
lookout for anyone trying to make trouble at any of the various
Branches in the Sinza District, and two Chinese Constables have
been posted at the Head Store, and Office, 101 Avenue Rd.,

It has been explained to the management that we are unable
to supply Police specially for every shop, but if they care to
apply for them on payment, we will endeavour if possible to
supply them.

This firm has five Branch Shops in the Sinza District,
in addition to the Head Office.

I am, Sir,

Yours obediently,

G. Phillip
Inspector.

D. O. "B" Div.

SHANGHAI,
September 1st 1932.

Dear Commissioner,

We are instructed by our clients, Messrs. Zee
Zong Dao & Co. (徐重道), a Chinese chain drug store with
their head office at 101 Avenue Road, to inform you that
their employees have staged a walk out for the past few
days and a negotiation between the employer and employees
for a settlement through the mediation of the Bureau of
Social Affairs of The Great Shanghai Municipality broke
down yesterday. The strikers are becoming more and more
unruly every day. They fear that some untoward incident
might take place at any moment at their head office. We
are therefore further instructed to write this letter to
you requesting that you would kindly give instruction to
the police station immediately concerned to detail a couple
of policemen at their premises for protection during the
trouble.

We believe you would kindly grant this request
and thank you very much in anticipation.

Yours faithfully,
Chen & Tsai

The Commissioner of Police,
Police Department,
Shanghai Municipal Police.

尊敬的警务总监：

受我们的客户徐重道公司（Messrs. Zee Zong Dao & Co.，徐重道）委托，这是一家总部位于爱文义路101号的中式连锁药房，特此通知阁下，其员工在过去几天内举行了罢工，雇主与员工在大上海市政府社会局的调解下进行的和解谈判于昨日破裂。罢工者日益桀骜不驯。他们担心总店随时可能发生不测事件。因此，我们进一步受权致函阁下，恳请阁下立即指令相关巡捕房，在动荡期间派遣数名警员驻守其处所以提供保护。

我们相信阁下会惠允此请求，并预先致以诚挚谢意。

此致，
敬礼，

陈蔡律师事务所

警务总监，
警务处，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
